address: Bedok Interchange Hawker Centre, #01-23, 208 New Upper Changi Road, 460208, Singapore
bio: The speciality here – mutton soup – is briny-sweet with plenty of umami, and finely shredded ginger to add zing. Other lamb specialities such as rib soup, kway teow, meatballs, lamb tendon and offal are also worth trying....
